test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error. **

options.text: He supposed he shuld be thankful.
He supposed he should be thankful.
He supposed he should be thankfull.
He suposed he should be thankful.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**He supposed he should be thankful.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Spelling errors can change the meaning of a sentence and make it difficult to understand.
 
• The sentence "He supposed he should be thankful." has no spelling error.
